decisions.reason: The digital anamnesis and consent app sits close to the firm's core dental practice software and gets its own page as a new product line, so the firm's related knowledge and in-house R&D let it interpret early results and improve the app.

The continuing education institute builds on the firm's existing training content and long dental industry experience, giving it enough related knowledge to run and refine the offer, though as a service it is somewhat further from core software development.

The remote screen-sharing support tool extends the firm's established customer support and integration capabilities, so it fits existing knowledge and is likely retained as part of the support offering.
